Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms

Class JdbcUserPhoneRepository

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms.JdbcUserPhoneRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserPhoneRepository
@Repository public class JdbcUserPhoneRepository extends Object implements UserPhoneRepository
UserPhoneRepository over the verified columns of the user_phones table. It opens no transaction: a save runs in the caller's, where it first takes a PostgreSQL transaction-level advisory lock on the number, so two users confirming the same number are serialised and the unique constraint is never violated (a violation would abort the caller's transaction).

    • UPSERT

      private static final String UPSERT
      Statement that stores the verified phone of a user, creating the row or updating its verified columns only (the pending ones are untouched), unless another user already owns the number. It runs after the lock of the number is taken, so (in the default READ COMMITTED isolation) it sees the row of any user who confirmed the same number before, and the unique constraint cannot be hit.
